# Godot pull request review

## Review the Godot change as rendered behavior

Inspect changed scenes, scripts, resources, node paths, signals, exported properties, and import settings together. Check nearest-neighbor and pixel-art constraints where applicable. Run the repository's Godot verifier and relevant tests. Treat headless CI as necessary but not sufficient for visual behavior: require a runtime screenshot, video, or equivalent rendered evidence before accepting claims about layout, animation, depth, input, or camera behavior. Report the exact failing path and distinguish editor-only, runtime-only, and CI-only findings.
